title: WMGK Collects 3,024 Turkeys at 25th Annual Turkey Drop
summary: PHILADELPHIA (Nov. 25, 2026) — Beasley Media Group’s 102.9 WMGK-FM collected 3,024 turkeys during its 25th annual Turkey Drop on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at 12 Acme
body_markdown:
**PHILADELPHIA (Nov. 25, 2026) —** Beasley Media Group’s 102.9 WMGK-FM collected 3,024 turkeys during its 25th annual Turkey Drop on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at 12 Acme Markets stores in Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Presented by Acme Markets, the fundraiser benefits CityTeam Chester, a nonprofit that helps families facing food insecurity in the greater Philadelphia area put Thanksgiving dinner on the table.


WMGK’s on-air personalities and office staff joined CityTeam staff outside participating stores from 7 to 10 a.m. to accept frozen turkeys, monetary donations and coupons for free turkeys. Nine stores in Pennsylvania and three in South Jersey served as collection sites. WMGK host Paul Kelly welcomed guests to the station’s studio as representatives of United Food & Commercial Workers Local 1776, Davis Honda, Always Best Care and Acme Markets made donations during the broadcast. Dietz & Watson helped transport the frozen turkeys from the collection sites to CityTeam Chester after the drive.


“Congratulations to the WMGK team on the 25th Turkey Drop and on the work it took to collect more than 3,000 turkeys in one morning,” said Paul Blake, VP and Market Manager of Beasley Media Group Philadelphia. “I’m grateful to every listener who stopped on their way to work, made an extra trip to the grocery store or gave online. Because you took the time to give, more families in our area can sit down to a Thanksgiving dinner together.”


The Turkey Drop supports CityTeam Chester’s holiday food assistance in the greater Philadelphia area. The nonprofit also provides meals and groceries throughout the year, including hot meals and fresh produce that people can take home. The Turkey Drop was made possible with support from Acme Markets, CityTeam Chester, Dietz & Watson and Davis Honda. The in-person collection has ended, and financial donations are still being accepted through


[CityTeam’s Turkey Drop donation page](https://www.cityteam.org/get-involved/turkeydrop?utm_source=chatgpt.com) .
